title: Terribly designed Ziplock bag organizers to put in a drawer or on a counter; cannot be hung
text:
Terribly designed Ziplock bag organizers to put in a drawer or on a counter; cannot be hung. This is a terribly designed Ziplock bag organizer that comes in four separate compartments with one each for quart, gallon, sandwich, and snack bags. Since this is not one unit, it cannot be hung on the wall. There are felt feet on the underside of the boxes for when it is placed on the counter or in a drawer. However, the beauty of this design is that each compartment can be configured anyway one desires. They can go in several separate drawers or in an L shape in one drawer, or side-by-side, etc.

Unfortunately, the design is terrible. First of all, I can easily load the bags through the large opening but it is designed for the bottom to slide out. This means if I turn over the compartment to load the bags from the bottom, the bags start to fall out of the top. In addition, the bottom is so loosely seated, it slides off if I am not careful when I pick up the compartment. If the bottom does slide off, they also have to be put back a certain way. If I accidentally use the top end and slide it in using the bottom side, it only slides halfway because each end is cut differently.

Personally, this set is a disappointment. No wonder it is so cheap at $17.99. Even though I love the way this keeps all my plastic bags in order, I cannot recommend it. Other options that are available for organizers like this are this [[ASIN:B09D5Y63D1 one]] if one is looking for four separate compartments. For a variety of organizers (separate and one unit), then I recommend this [[ASIN:B09KMNHM2J one]] or this [[ASIN:B09VGP1WRL one]]. For one full unit only, then I recommend this [[ASIN:B09RF759BM rustic organizer]]. For a more modern look, I recommend this [[ASIN:B09WN5PZ6Q one]]. For a larger unit that has room for foil and plastic wrap, then I highly recommend this [[ASIN:B0B1TPD21S one]]. I tried all of these and the style purchased is based on what one desires. I personally like these other ones a little better than this one.
